summary: Staff-level backend engineer with deep expertise in Go and distributed systems, including production experience building services for high-scale orchestration and microservice environments. Proven track record architecting and leading distributed systems across defense simulation, financial services, and consumer platforms, with hands-on experience in task queues, worker fleets, and workflow orchestration patterns.

bullets.text: Owned approximately 6 Spring Boot services (Java 8 and 17) for the Navigator passenger app used by thousands of passengers per cruise across 8 ships, deployed partially on-prem and partially in AWS

Reduced cruise data load times approximately 10x by separating historical and future data endpoints and loading past data asynchronously, decreasing API response times from several seconds to under 500ms
Built end-to-end test harnesses where none existed and improved local execution environment enabling up to 5 distributed services to run locally, benefiting all ~8 service-based engineers
Owned deployment of services to ships and shore using Jenkins and Harness with zero incidents during tenure, leveraging a homegrown feature flag system for controlled rollout across the fleet
Reduced service latency from ~10 seconds to milliseconds by identifying and resolving lock contention in two shared services using Splunk and Dynatrace distributed traces at Edward Jones
Built and deployed a prototype Go service to GCP as part of an internal learning cohort, gaining hands-on experience with Go testing and fuzzing

Owned Trip Trading and Give Away (TTGA) functions end-to-end as part of Southwest Airlines crew scheduling monolith decomposition following the December 2022 crisis, integrating with crew bidding systems
Delivered production microservices as member of a 6-person pod decomposing a legacy monolith for Edward Jones, deployed to AWS with Kubernetes orchestration

Integrated VR-Forces CGF simulation with Apache Kafka via C++ plugins, forwarding live simulation data to Docker-containerized services for automated data collection and trainee task scoring across distributed simulation environments

Led team of 3 engineers as architect for the Intelligent After Action Review (IAAR) tool across full SDLC, integrating a GIFT rules engine to automate report generation from simulation events stored in PostgreSQL
Co-developed IAAR React frontend, implemented automated PowerPoint report generation, and contributed to GIFT rules engine integration driving trainee evaluation and remediation recommendations
Modernized CCTT manned simulator hardware I/O by replacing a mid-90s bespoke system with off-the-shelf WAGO hardware across 100+ simulators at ~6 training sites, porting all Ada 95 logic
Integrated a proprietary blockchain ledger platform into RBC applications as a customer loyalty program ledger, wrapping it in a Spring Boot microservice layer with OpenAPI-designed REST API
Built Android (Java) and iOS (Swift) SDKs integrating with the loyalty services, deployed to ~1,000 users in a pilot deployment
Architected service-oriented distributed simulation for UK Army Scout vehicle using RTI Connext DDS as the real-time communications bus, leading a team of ~5 engineers across Orlando and the UK

Led development of the Instructor/Operator Station (IOS) simulation control product for F-16 and F-35 trainers, leading 7 engineers across 2 locations and implementing CI/CD pipelines for deployment into 3 separate simulations

Led WARSIM R&D team of 3 engineers, rearchitecting C2 reporting from a single feed to three live situational awareness feeds to GCCS-J using HLA, enabling first joint training events with Army, Navy, and Air Force
Led team of 3 engineers as software lead for C2 on SE Core program, building the C2 common vehicular component for AVCATT integrating with MCS and BFT tactical systems for the first time
Developed, tested, and integrated OneSAF distributed simulation with multiple Army C2 systems including FBCB2, AFATDS, and BCS3
Led effort to rehost CCTT distributed simulation from IBM AIX to Linux PCs, including endianness conversion and network packet debugging across a team of developers
Developed simulation code for CCTT manned modules in Ada, integrating 20-40 manned simulators per site with TCP/IP networking and DIS protocol across distributed systems
